nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The CSV may directly name a mature miRNA.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The six columns describe species, target, GeneID, experiment, and support, with no miRNA name field.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Association labels are withheld; target identifiers and evidence strings are the remaining linkage variables.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Profile every row and locate a curated interaction reference before ranking candidates.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The original miRTarBase download URLs are accessible from this container.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The CUHK URLs returned 403 and the older domain did not resolve, while Enrichr and OmniPath returned 200.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The original hosting endpoints block retrieval; this does not establish that the curated associations are unavailable elsewhere.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Rank candidates with the bounded Enrichr library and inspect a short OmniPath preview for evidence-level resolution.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: OmniPath's interaction preview could provide the experiment and support fields needed for exact matching.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The response includes references and source names but no experiment or support columns.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: OmniPath aggregates interaction evidence at the miRNA–target edge, losing assay-level distinctions in this response.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Locate an assay-level source and use assay-stratified overlaps to see which evidence separates candidates.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: All three candidate repositories can be inspected through recursive HEAD trees in parallel.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Two tree requests returned HTTP 409; the only successful response exposed a legacy text table but the parallel output did not associate it with a repository name.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The failed tree responses contain no file inventory, and interleaved output obscured the successful result's provenance.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Read labeled repository metadata and test a bounded, filtered extract from the likely legacy archive while checking newer reference endpoints.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Python's default quote-aware TSV reader can parse this archive directly.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The reader aborted on a field exceeding 131,072 bytes; the reference preview showed both quoted and unquoted records.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The failure occurred at reference parsing, before ranking. Quote state can absorb physical row boundaries in this mixed-format export.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Split each physical line on tabs, remove field-edge quotes, and report unexpected widths before interpreting the assay-aware ranks.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The legacy archive settles the ranking.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The archive covers 173 of 542 distinct cohort signatures and ranks hsa-let-7d-5p first, while the broader 2017 gene-only comparison ranks hsa-let-7f-5p first.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The two references differ in vintage and evidence granularity; a lead in a partially covered subset is not the full-cohort frequency.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Locate a newer evidence-level reference and assess whether the legacy matches cover different assay groups for the two candidates.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The legacy ranking discrepancy reflects a cohort-wide difference between candidates rather than position-dependent coverage.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Nearly all let-7d exact matches are in the first 600 rows, whereas nearly all let-7f exact matches occur later; both candidates lack legacy matches for the dominant PAR-CLIP assay.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Row order and assay are associated with source label, and the archive preferentially covers different assays in the two groups.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Localize the transition and locate a newer evidence table through repository metadata.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The two halves are substantially duplicated in row order.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The longest exact matching run across halves was two rows, and no large repeat-offset peak was observed.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Shared targets cause repeated signatures without preserving their row order, so repeats do not mark a source boundary.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Probe the newer reference with byte ranges and inspect candidate-exclusive genes near the transition.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The newer mirror is ordered by candidate and permits a contiguous byte-range retrieval for each miRNA.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Range reads returned mixed miRNAs grouped by ascending interaction ID, including many miRNAs associated with the same target.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Interaction ID and target grouping scatter the candidate records across the high-throughput reference section.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Use the saved full-cohort data to test the inferred split via shared assay-signature multiplicities, without a bulk transfer.
